build.buildCommand: npm install && cd apps/api && npx prisma generate && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: cd apps/api && (npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss || echo 'DB push skipped') && (node dist/prisma/seed.js || true) && API_PORT=4000 node dist/src/main.js & sleep 5 && cd apps/web && npx next start -p ${PORT:-3000}
